I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread: the next Tansleigh Packaging renewal is 25 September, and that replaces the date from their earlier post. A renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to have in the team channel. I didn't go back and check the earlier post, and there's nothing else to do.

One thing to watch: the clock says 14 October 2026, so 25 September has already passed this year. Hollis probably means 25 September 2027, but I didn't ask them to confirm the year.
